# LatVeneer

> LatVeneer (SIA LatVeneer) is a birch veneer mill in Jēkabpils, Latvia, producing
> FSC®-certified, rotary-cut (spindleless-peeled) core birch veneer for plywood and
> moulded-plywood-furniture manufacturers across Europe. The mill also buys birch
> roundwood (veneer logs) locally in Latvia.

## Key facts

- Company: SIA LatVeneer, Reg. No. 40203561748, VAT LV40203561748
- Mill & deliveries: Ausekļa iela 3A, Jēkabpils, LV-5201, Latvia
- Legal address: Ausekļa iela 1, Jēkabpils, LV-5201, Latvia
- Contact: info@latveneer.lv · +371 28 298 028
- Product: spindleless-peeled (rotary-cut) core birch veneer, Latvian silver birch
- Production lines: two spindleless peeling lines (1300 mm and 1600 mm), two further lines being installed
- Sheet sizes (mm): 1300×1300, 1300×1600, 1300×2600, 1600×1300, 1600×1600, 1600×3100
- Thickness: 1.5 mm standard; 1.0–3.0 mm on request; target thickness tolerance 0.02 mm
- Grades: ABCD and E grade packs, manually inspected and sorted
- Drying: 32 m four-belt dryer fired with recycled woodchips; 4–8% target moisture
- Certification: FSC®-certified (Percentage and Transfer systems); every pallet traced individually; EUDR/DDS traceability in progress
- Rated A (highest company rating) by the Latvian State Revenue Service for 2025
- Log buying: birch roundwood, payable lengths 2.70/3.00/3.20/3.30 m, measurement every working day 07:00–19:00
